QUAD 405 · POWER AMPLIFIER

Restoring your Quad 405

The Quad 405 is a power amplifier of about 100 watts per channel. It drives your loudspeakers. The later version is called the 405-2.

This guide is new. Nobody has checked its parts list against a real Quad 405 yet, so treat it as a starting point.

Before anything else: stay safe

This power amplifier plugs into the mains. Parts inside can still give you a dangerous shock after it is unplugged.

If you are new to electronics, don't open it. You can do everything on this page from the outside. A qualified technician does the work inside.

Four steps

1

Write down a few details

You can find all of these from the outside.

  • The serial number.
  • What the front says: 405 or 405-2. From serial 62,500, some amplifiers badged "405" already have 405-2 parts inside.
  • Whether the inputs on the back are a round DIN socket or RCA (phono) sockets.
  • Anything already done to it.
2

Talk it through with an AI assistant

An AI assistant with the Quad Agent guide checks your details against Quad's own documents and tells you what applies to your Quad 405. It asks questions first and never guesses part values.

Copy this into your AI assistant:

Read quad-upgrade/SKILL.md and follow it to help me restore my Quad 405. Start by helping me identify it from the outside.

It needs the guide files first. Download the guide and add it to your assistant, or give it the quad-upgrade folder.

3

Choose what you want done

The recap

A recap replaces the ageing capacitors, the chip at each input and the parts that power it. DADA's kit also replaces the loudspeaker terminals and inputs, and the wiring inside.

Optional extras

These change how the Quad 405 behaves. You don't need any of them.

  • Lower sensitivity. Makes the 405 need a stronger signal, which DADA says also lowers noise and distortion. Leave it as standard if your preamp is happy as it is.
4

Take it to a technician

Send them the link to this page. Everything they need is in the section below: the parts list, Quad's service documents and the upgrade guides.

Ask them to check the parts against your actual Quad 405 before ordering. Quad changed things during production, and earlier owners may have too.

Good to know

  • The big capacitors inside stay charged for a long time after you switch off. Only a technician should open it.
  • Early 405s have no protection for your speakers if a fault happens. DADA says some protection should be fitted, and sells a board for it.
  • The two sources give slightly different figures for checking it afterwards. Both are listed for your technician.
